subject: Change order: mitigation of fee drift & rollback schedule
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@astrolabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, AstroLabs Procurement <procurement@astrolabs.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: change order for May overages + rollback protection

Irene —

Thanks for taking this on. We pulled our May invoice and saw a ~28% overage vs the committed throughput tiers. We believe this is behavioral (batch size changes in our inference pipeline) and not a sustained uplift, so we're asking for a short-term change order that: 1) adds a temporary buffer of reserved capacity for June (to avoid repeated throttles), and 2) includes a fee-drift mitigation clause so we can revert to prior pricing if usage normalizes in Q3 without retrospective billing.

I attached our May usage export and a short note from engineering explaining the burst pattern. We want to avoid protracted legal negotiations but need guardrails so this doesn't balloon our costs. Happy to take a short call — procurement would like an execution timeline by EOW.

Jordan Miles
VP Product
AstroLabs, Inc.
Attachment: AstroLabs_Usage_Report_May2028.csv (csv)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@astrolabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order for May overages + rollback protection

Jordan — thanks for the detail and the usage file. We can absolutely do a time-limited change order that combines a temporary capacity top-up with a fee-protection window. High-level proposal:

- Temporary reserved pool for June (pro-rated for partial month) to prevent throttles.
- Fee-drift mitigation: a 60-day observation window after the top-up; if average daily throughput returns to baseline within that window, we apply a one-time credit to cover the delta for the top-up period (no retroactive rate changes).
- Limited retroactivity: credits only, no rollback of previously paid invoices.

I've looped in Karthik to draft the commercial language and Laura for legal redlines. I'll draft a slim change order skeleton (AL_changeorder_draft_v1.docx) and share within the hour. If procurement needs execution by EOW, we should aim to have a DocuSign-ready doc by Thu COB.

Short call? I'm available Wed 10:30–11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, GTM Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: AL_changeorder_draft_v1.docx (docx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jmiles@astrolabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order for May overages + rollback protection — pricing note

Jordan/Irene —

Quick commercial note from my side after looking at the usage CSV:

- Proposed temporary top-up: +1 reserved unit (standard qps) for June; pro-rate 14/30 days = 0.467 month charge.
- Observation window: 60 days after June 30. If mean daily tokens fall within 10% of April baseline, we credit the prorated top-up amount.
- If utilization remains elevated, the top-up converts to a monthly supplement and standard committed pricing applies.

Risk/ops note: if AstroLabs needs to test large batch sizes again, we should also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for the burst window to reduce per-token cost — engineering can do a short config change.

I've attached a quick cost calc and will fold these numbers into the change order language. Laura — please advise on whether the credit language above is workable or if legal wants tighter language on audit/access during the observation window.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations
Attachment: cost_calc_AL_topup_Jun2028.xlsx (xls)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jmiles@astrolabs.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order for May overages + rollback protection — legal redlines

Team/Jordan —

Attached is a redline summary (redline_summary_legal.pdf) and a marked-up change order. High-level legal positions:

1) Retroactivity/credits: we can provide a one-time credit as proposed but must limit any audit rights to usage logs for the observation window only; no broad access to internal telemetry.
2) Term language: the top-up will be expressly time-limited to the month of June; conversion to a longer-term commitment requires a signed amendment.
3) Definition clarity: we need to define "baseline" and measurement method (rolling 30-day mean as measured in Redwood's billing system).
4) SLA/fallback: recommend adding the fallback model-variant clause (if capacity constrained, Redwood may route to a compatible model variant) and note it does not alter functional output guarantees.
5) Liability: keep credit as sole remedy for fee drift; avoid reopening indemnities.

I've proposed specific language for the credit calculation and a sample audit clause in the attachment. If acceptable, we can prepare a clean DocuSign envelope. Jordan — if procurement can accept the limited audit scope, we should be able to get this signed quickly.

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redline_summary_legal.pdf (pdf), AL_changeorder_redline_v2.docx (docx)

From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@astrolabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AstroLabs Procurement <procurement@astrolabs.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order for May overages + rollback protection — acceptance pending DocuSign

Irene/Laura/Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and clear redlines. Procurement reviewed the changes with legal and we're OK with the limited audit scope and the credit-as-sole-remedy approach. Two tiny asks:

1) Please add a parenthetical clarifying the baseline is April 2028 only (we want deterministic measurement for the credit).
2) Can you pro-rate the top-up charge using actual activation date (not calendar day) — we'll accept your pro-rate calc as long as it's transparent in the change order.

If you can make those two edits and send a DocuSign link, procurement will execute. Target: sign by Fri COB.

Jordan Miles
VP Product
AstroLabs, Inc.
Attachment: signed_PO_page_stub.pdf (pdf)
Onward_comment: Procurement asked for execution by EOW; internal follow-ups will include final DocuSign envelope and accounting booking once signed.
